metadata.title: PS-Connect
metadata.description:
This script connects to the primary o365 functions to allow management and setup scripts to creat security entities.
this script connects to msonline, exchnage, teams, sharepoint, ad after installing all ther required modules to do so.
it also sets the local execution policy.
All edit scripts are run seperately, this script makes no changes to ms online services, and only edits the execurition policy on the local machine
